description: Search open jobs on workfinds.app. Returns at most 50 jobs per search, in pages of 20 (pages 1 to 3), newest first unless sort is "relevance", each with a workfinds.app page URL, plus the total and a search_url that opens the same search on the site. Every argument is optional; combine them to narrow the search.

company_id.description: Only this company's jobs: the id or page slug from get_company or a job's company.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the person will work from, e.g. "PH". Returns jobs open to applicants from that country, worldwide remote jobs included. See list_countries.

employment_type.description: Any of full_time, part_time, contract, temporary, internship.

posted_within.description: Only jobs published within the last 24h, 3d, 7d, 14d or 30d.

query.description: Words to search for: a job title, skill or company name, e.g. "data engineer".

salary_listed.description: Only jobs whose employer lists a salary.

sort.description: newest (default) or relevance (only with a query).

name: search_jobs

eligibility.description: Countries people may apply from, as the employer states them.

posted_at.description: ISO 8601, when the employer published it.

salary.description: As the employer lists it; null when not listed.

title: Search jobs
